tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu chos drug gi zhal shes dgos pa rnams kyi lhan thabs bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos drug 'di nā ro pa'i bzhed kyis ma brgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa/ de las kye rdo rje'i man ngag tu bzhed/ ni gu ma'i bzhed kyis pha brgyud ma brgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa khyad par du rin chen rgya mtsho'i rgyud la brten par bzhed do/ /rin po che'i gsung gi gsang 'dus le'u bco lnga pa las rmi lam gyi 'od gsal gyis chos mang du byas pas zin so gsang 'dus che bar 'dug gsungs/ a'i stong ra'i skabs su gos dri ma can la tshos mi chags pa bzhin/ de la dge sbyor mi skye zhing thar pa mi thob/ thar pa bas mi lus kyang mi thob ste/ blo gros mi zad pas/ bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni/ /mi'i lus kyang thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ spyod pa 'di 'dra ni sgo gsum 'khrul pa la spyod pa la zer ro/ /sdig pa sbyong ba la nā ro chos drug nas maṇḍal yi ge brgya pa la sogs pa yod pa la/ 'dir a'i stong ra gcig pu la dril bas spros pa chung zhing sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags myur du ting nge 'dzin skye sla bas zab pa'i gnad yin gsungs/ sdig sgrib la chos 'byung phyi nang gnyis ka dkar ba/ nad la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ rlung la rang gi 'og tu mar nag gi mtsho kha chung la gting ring ba reg bya tsha ba/ rlangs pa dang bcas pa'i nang mig man chad nub pa la/ a'i bdud rtsi zhun mar gyi rnam par byung nas rlung gi nad thams cad zhi bar bsam/ tshad pa la bdud rtsi dkar la reg bya bsil ba/ grang ba la bdud rtsi dmar la reg bya tsha ba/ gdon la bdud rtsi khro bo'i rnam pa la khro chung mang po byung ste/ gdon thams cad srog chags kyi rnam pa sdig pa dang sbal pa 'bu srog la sogs pa lung par mi shong ba tsam thon pas lus phru ma phus btab pa bzhin song bar bsam mo/

/rtags ni ri rtse gangs rtser 'dzegs pa/ nyi zla shar ba gos med thon pa khrus byas pa/ bu mo gzhon nu ma'i mgo la me tog 'phreng ba 'dogs pa la sogs pa rmi ste/ phyi ma ni mkha' 'gro ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rtags kyang yin/ dngos su yang lus bzo mdog bde ba dang / ldang ba yang ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /dngos gzhi brgyud la skye ba la sngon 'gro tshad la phebs dgos pa sngon 'gro la 'jug pa gal che/ mkhas grub chos rjes ngas zhag bzhi bcu sngon 'gro la 'bungs gsung / ༈ /gtum mo'i skabs su gnas lugs kyi don zab mo bzhi la gzhug pa la sngags mtshan nyid gnyis mthun/ yang mngon du byed pa'i thabs zab mi zab yod de/ spros bral nam mkha' lta bur 'jog pa pha rol tu phyin pa la yang yod pas khyad chos min/ rten lus la gnad du bsnun pas dran pa sems la rtogs pa 'char ba 'di khyad chos yin pas/ sngags pa rnams kyi rlung bsgom dgos/ rlung la yang drod dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa mu stegs pa la yang yod pas/ rlung gi stobs kyis kun gzhi rnam shes byin gyis brlabs te/ mchog gi gnas su bzhugs te/ ye shes skye ba gcig dgos/ rlung zhi drag gang rung bstun te ma bsgoms na dbang gnyis pa'i dam tshig dang yang 'gal/ des na birwa pas 'bring dam tshig dang sdom pa'i lam zhes pa dang gnad gcig ste/ dbang bzhi'i lam bzhi ma bsgoms na dam tshig 'chor med du mi 'byung ba'o/ /me'i lha yin pas rje btsun ma nges par bsgom/ zhal gcig ma dang phyag gnyis ma rang gang mos su bsgom/ dmigs pa kun btags bsgom pa min/ dngos la gnas pa gsal 'debs pa yin te/ rkang pa bgrad pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'chang zung yar bstan pa g.yo byed ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ gsum mdo'i me ri ri bong gi ril ma tsam dmigs pa gang bde'o/ /dmigs pa mi gsal bar rlung shor na yon tan mi skye bas gsal btab la rlung zungs/

bsgom bya don gyi gnad 'chugs na yon tan mi skye zhing gegs su 'gyur bas lus ngag yid gsum gnad ma 'chugs par bya/ rlung dang shes pa lte 'og tu 'dzin pa gnad che/ stod du las na gegs 'byung / me rlung bsgom pa dang rjes mi rtog par 'jog pa gnyis spel mar byas pas rtog med la brten nas drod dang bde ba la bogs 'byung / drod la brten nas mi rtog ye shes skye'o/ /de'ang me rgod gtum mo ni mi rgod ltar gtum pa'am stobs che la myur bas mi rgod dang mtshungs pa'o// ༈ /dbang po rab kyi skabs su sa bcu lam lnga thams cad bla ma'i man ngag gcig pus bgrod par byed de/ ye shes mngon 'byung las/ sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /bla ma'i mos gus lo zlas bgrod/ /bla ma'i snang ba mi 'bral na/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral med gnas/ /zhes dang / ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu mas/ /sa bcu lam lnga'i rim pa rnams/ /mos gus stobs kyis bgrod par byed/ /bla ma'i snang ba mi 'bral na/ /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /ces so/ /lha sku bskal pa stong du bsgom pa bas/ bla ma dran pa bsod nams che ste/ ye shes gsal ba sgron me'i rgyud las/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lha/ /bskal pa stong du bsgoms pa bas/ /bla ma dran pa bsod nams che/ /zhes so/ /sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan 'dzin te/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ gsang ba sngags las byung ba yin/ /bla ma'i drin dang ldan pa nyid/ /snying gi dkyil lam rkang pa'i mthil/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu sus sgom pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan yang / /gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dam tshig bkod pa las/ g.yo med mos gus zla drug gis/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob 'gyur/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las zhes bya/

/zhes dang / gur las/ slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /'di nyid yid la bsam par bya/ /de ni ci yi phyir zhe na/ /rdo rje sems dang sangs rgyas spyan/ /de bzhin rdo rje gzi brjid dang / /padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / /rta yi rgyal po'i dngos grub ni/ /gang phyir de la dka' ba med/ /ces dang / gsang 'dus las/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu nyag gcig lhag /ces dang / rdo rje slob dpon ni bdag cag phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha'o/ /ma'o/ /bskyed pa'o/ /zhes dang / sdom pa 'byung ba las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /zhes so/ /rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje spyan zhabs pad la 'dud/ /ces so/ /mchod rten brtsegs pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /mtshan brjod las/ mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gis gnas/ /rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os/ /bskur 'os mchod pa bya ba'i mchog /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ /ces so/ /mkha' 'gro ma thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bsnyen bkur byas pa bas ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la til mar gyis byugs pa bsod nams ches khyad par du 'phags so/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /de'i gzugs kyi phung po ni/

/sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad do/ /zhes sogs lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bor bshad do/ /saṃ bu ṭa las/ gang phyir phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams bas/ /slob dpon ba spu'i khung gcig mchog /ces so/ /bsdus pa las/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /zhes so/ /ba tshwa can chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyis gnas/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /ces so/ /sa ra has/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zab cing rgya che las/ /sgrol bar byed pa'i gru mchog de ni gzhan min te/ /zhes so/ /chos rje sa skya pas/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang / /me shel med na me mi 'byung / /de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang / /bla ma med par 'byung mi nus/ /zhes so/ /bla ma rmog lcog pa'i gsung las/ tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba la bla ma la mos gus dgos/ mos gus la bla ma'i snang ba dang mi 'bral ba gcig dgos gsungs te/ khong gi thag chod kyi gsung las/ thugs rje chen po rang shel dkar na yang dkar/ dges rdor bde mchog rang sngo na'ang sngo/ rdo rje phag mo rang dmar na'ang dmar/ nga la ni re sa bla ma las med/ ji ltar 'dug kyang bla ma'i snang ba dang 'bral ma myong bas/ tshe gcig lus gcig gi sangs rgyas sam de yong yong 'dra gsung ngo / /bla ma skyer sgang pa'i zhal nas/ tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba la bla ma'i mos gus dgos/ mos gus la bla ma yang yang du dran pa bu gcig pu shi ba'i ma lta bu gcig dgos/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyi zhal nas/ bla ma'i mos gus la zhe thag pa nas snying khong rus pa'i gting nas mchi ma rang dbang med par gsol ba 'debs pa gcig dgos gsung ngo / /sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma'i mos gus la brjed nges log ltar ma song ba dgos gsung ngo /

/zhang bla ma gnyan gyis zhal nas/ bla ma rje btsun chen po/ rin po che 'bri khung pa/ zhang rin po che dus gsum mkhyen pa/ gtsang pa rgya ras/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa la sogs kyi drung du phyin pas bla ma'i mos gus gcig pus sa lam bgrod pa la thams cad mthun par gda' gsung ngo / /bla ma'i gsung gis/ bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ rgyud rang grol dang snang ba bden med du 'khyams song na dmigs pa la sogs pa'i gnad kyis dge sbyor dam dum skye yang mthar thug mi skye bas/ bla ma la chos sku'i 'du shes skyes na bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu ma rang shar/ rmi lam rang zin/ 'od gsal rang shar/ bar do rang 'byongs su 'byung gsung // ༈ /dbang po 'bring gi skabs su/ sgyu ma lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/ ting nge 'dzin des rnam par spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' myur du mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgom byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas/ /rmi lam lta bu zhes sngar bzhin gsungs so/ /khye'u rab snang gi skabs su/ nor po che gcig la bu gcig las med pas bu rab tu byung na/ nor rgyal pos 'khyer bas rab tu byung du mi ster te/ des bdag sangs rgyas la rab tu byung du pha mas ma gnang bas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan dang bcas te khyim na gnas bzhin du 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag gcig zhu 'tshal zhes gsol ba dang / chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam la sogs par gsungs so/ /gang gi tshig brjod dran gyur na/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya nges/ /zhes so/ /ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar rmi lam na yang 'dod pa dran/ /skyes bu sad par gyur na mi mthong ltar/ /byis pa de ni 'dod la chags shing zhen/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes dang / las rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ 'gro kun skyes pa bud med sna tshogs pa/

/de dag rang gi sems dang tha dad med/ /de kun sgyu ma'i snang bar rab shes na/ /de tshe sangs rgyas lag pa'i mthil bstod 'gyur/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ rang lus sgyu ma'i rnam par rab shes pa/ /'gro kun skyes pa bud med sna tshogs par/ /thams cad gzugs ni sgyu ma'i rnam pa las/ /mkhas pa su dag de las gzhan du brjod/ /ces so/ /gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ sgyu ma 'di ni yod med las 'das shing / /dbu ma tsam du'ang mi gnas kun rdzob ste/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma'i snang ba las/ /'gag pa med pa'i rol pa rang shar 'byung / /zhes so/ /lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ snang ba ma nges pa ni ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bka' bstsal pa/ sa la sar snang ba yod/ sa la chu/ sa la me/ sa la rlung / sa la nam mkhar snang ba yod de/ de'i phyir ma nges so/ /zhes so/ /de yang srog chags sbal pas sa la nam mkha'i 'du shes yod pas/ kho sa 'og nas rgyugs pas steng nas rta rgyugs pas mi zin/ rgya yul na me byi yod pas me la zas gos kyi snang ba shar bas/ me byi stobs dang ldan pa lug tsam yod/ me chung na mdangs med pa byi la tsam du 'gro/ nam mkha' la sar 'du shes pa ni/ mu stegs rtag pa bas/ nam mkha' la lag pa rgyab pas rtog sgra yong bas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis lho phyogs kong ka nar byon pa na/ lo thog dang rtsi shing thams cad nam mkha' la skyes 'dug nas/ nged kyi yul na sa la skyes byas pas blor ma chud gsung / zhang bya rog dang mi'i nyin mo la/ srin bya dang 'ug pa'i mtshan mo dang / khong gnyis kyis nyin mo la mi dang bya rog gi mtshan mor 'du shes pas/ de yang snang ba ma nges pa'o/ /zhes gsung ngo / /gsol ba sgyu ma lta bu ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bka' bstsal pa/ rgya gar gyi yul dbus na rgyal po dpa' ba sdug cing legs pa gcig 'dug pas/ rta sred byung nas btsun mos sgyu ma mkhan bos nas rta la skyo ba'i thabs gyis shig byas pas/

sgyu ma mkhan gyis rta tsho ba legs pa gzugs bzang ba mgyogs pa gcig sprul nas sgo drung na 'dug btsun mos rgyal po gser khri la bzhugs pa la rta mi nyo'am byas pas/ rta ji 'dra gcig 'dug byas pas/ sngar gyi de rnams las ches lhag pa gcig 'dug byas pas/ rings pa'i tshul gyis sgyu ma mkhan gyi rtsar song nas rin ji tsam 'dod zer/ rgyal srid phyed 'dod byas pas/ chags thogs med par 'jal nus pa byung / yang rtsa na mi gcig byung nas/ khong gcig po bdag po min/ tshong gsha' ma gcig byed na btsun mo'i phyed 'jal nus sam/ nus par byung / yang rtsa na mi gcig byung nas khong tsho yang bdag po ni min/ tshong gsha' ma gcig byed na sras dam pa rnams kyi phyed 'dod byas pas/ cung zad the tshom byas nas bang 'gros ji 'dra yod zer/ rgyal po rang gzigs gcig byas nas/ der zhon pas rgyal po rtas khyer te/ bskal par phyin yang mi bgrod pa'i rtsi shing la sogs pa gang yang med par/ gcan gzan gdug pa can rgyu ba'i thang chen po gcig gi 'gram na mtsho gcig 'dug pa'i rtsar rgyal po bskyur nas rta de mtsho la mchongs song / rgyal pos mya ngan byed cing phyogs gcig na phar phyin pas dud dri gcig byung / mi dang 'phrad par 'gyur snyam nas btsal bas grog po gcig gi nang na khang chung gcig gi nang na rgan rgon gnyis la bu mo mdog shin tu legs pa gcig dang / bu dig pa gcig 'dug sngar gyi lo rgyus brjod pas/ rgan rgon gnyis na re/ da khyed rang gi khab tu phyin pas btsun mo dang 'phrad pa mi 'ong bas nged kyi bu mo dang lhan cig sdod zer/ bsdad pas lo bdun song bu tsha lnga byung / de nas rgan po na re/ rgyal po khyod bsod nams dang ldan pa yin pas/ bu dig pa 'di la byams su gyis shig zer nas mtsho de la mchongs song / de bzhin du rgan mo dang bu mo rnams kyang rim gyis de skad zer zhing mchongs song /

mthar lkugs pa yang kha 'byed nas/ rgyal po khyed bsod nams che bas skyid par gyis zer nas mchongs song / der rgyal po mya ngan skyes nas/ nyi grib mtshams la rngams ring na ra ra 'dug der btsun mo na re/ da sor ma yong bas sgyu ma shig zer bshig pas/ lo bdun la grib ma sor bdun las ma 'das par 'dug des na skad cig ma yun du 'khrul ba yin/ der rgyal pos rgyal srid btsun mo dang bcas pa thams cad sngar gyi sgyu ma dang khyad mi 'dug snyam nas/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du rab tu byung nas bsgrubs pas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ lha'i bu sgyu ma ni de lta bu zhes gsungs so/ /yang gsol ba 'phags pa rmi lam ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bka' bstsal pa/ rgya gar lho phyogs na rgyal po zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba la bu mo gzugs mdzes pa lta na sdug pa rin po che'i rgyan dang chas su yod pa gcig la/ re shig na de mya ngan gyi khang par bzhugs par gyur te/ g.yog mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang nas drag pa gcig gis/ lha gcig 'di lta bu'i phun tshogs pa'i dus su ci'i phyir mya ngan byed dris pas/ 'byor pa kas bdag gi khyim zlar gyur pa'i 'os mi rnyed pas so/ /zhes dang / 'o skol rang gi dgra zlar gyur pa la bu mdzes shing lta na sdug pa gcig yod pas de dang gnyen bya'o/ /byas pa dang rung zer nas rin po che'i rgyan srang bye ba ri ba gcig bskur/ rgyal pos kyang de lta bu gcig bskur skad/ der dgyes nas yod pas rmi lam du rgyal bu mdzes pa dang 'grogs nas bu yid du 'ong ba gcig btsas pas dga'/ de nas bu shi nas mya ngan du gyur pa dang gnyid sad khar sangs rgyas ye shes bla mas dza ya siddhi bsod snyoms blangs gsungs pa'i mod la/ ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ /bu pho skyes shing shi ba de mthong nas/ /byung na dga' zhing shi na mi dga' ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/

/zhes thos shing rmi lam dran pas skyo ba skyes te khyim spangs te bsgrubs pas 'bras bu thob ste rmi lam lta bu'o/ /yang lha'i bu'i gsol ba snang ba mi bden pa brdzun pa yin na/ ci'i phyir sa rdo brag la sogs pa sra zhing 'thas par snang zhes gsol ba dang / bka' bstsal pa/ lha'i bu dag drang srong mes byin gyis stag tu bsgoms nas des mi mang po zos pa dang / yang dge slong gcig la klu srin mo gcig gnod pa la keng rus su bsgoms pas/ de'i bag chags brtas nas nga la ma reg cig 'jig par 'gyur ro zhes bag chags yun thung bas kyang de ltar las 'thas su 'gyur na/ thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i bag chags ngan pa la yun du goms pas ci'i phyir bden par mi 'dzin te/ las 'thas su zhen pa'o/ /lha'i bu de'i phyir mi bden par rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni bden par snang yang chos thams cad rdzun pa'i skabs su sbyor bar gnang ngo / /de yang sgyu ma ni snang la bden med gcig la zer te/ ni gu ma'i gsung gi snang yang bden par ma grub cing / /stong yang 'dzin pas ma bslad pa/ /zhes so/ /de yang sgyu ma'i snang ba de rgyu rkyen tshogs na 'byung gi ma tshogs na mi 'byung ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dwangs shing nam mkha' la sgrib byed med na 'dzam bu'i gling gi chu skyogs thams cad zla ba'i gzugs brnyan du 'char zhing / chu skyogs 'gyel na zla ba chus khyer ba'am snod la thim pa min te/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pa zhig pas mi snang ba'o/ /sangs rgyas ston pas skyes pa stag dong dang bcas nas 'tshang rgya/ bud med bal bskur dang bcas nas 'tshang rgya/ gtso bo 'dun ma dang bcas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i chos yin gsung ngo // ༈ /jo bo rje dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi gtam rgyud la brten nas nges shes bskyed pa ni// jo bo rje rgya gar nas byon dus/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i thugs dgongs la/

ngas mkhas lding gi gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs nas/ 'og gi bya spyod kyis lha tshogs la phyag mdzub btsugs nas bstod pa re mdzad pas/ bya spyod kyis rgyus che bar 'dug snyam/ bar yo ga'i lha la bstod pas yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇḍi ta yin nam snyam/ steng bla med kyi lha la bstod pas yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇḍi tar shes nas mos so/ /der jo bo'i zhal nas lha'i bkod pa 'di rnams legs/ nyams su ji ltar len gsungs/ thun gsum du rim pa bzhin bsgom zhus pas snying po bsdu mi shes par 'dug gsungs nas ma mnyes pas nga rgyal chag nas/ gdams pa tshig nyung la don 'dril ba nyams su blangs bde ba gcig zhu byas pas de yang yin te/ chos byas na 'thad gsungs/ sgom pa la mi mnyes par 'dug snyam nas bshad dam byas pas sngar bzhin gsungs/ de'i don ma go nas zhus pas tshe 'di blos thong gsungs/ der sngar gyi mthar thug bcu gsum la sogs pa'ang tshe 'di'i rgyan du song 'dug pas/ da tshe 'di blos btang gi sgrub pa gcig byed par zhus pas jo bo'i gsung gi rgya lo tsā ba shi bas nga'i lce chad/ da khyed 'gro dgos gsungs pas dbu se song ba bstan nas da bdag tshe 'di blos btang gi sgrub pa gcig cis kyang byed par zhu zhus nas/ phyi sgo la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rin chen bzang po khyed dus da nas 'tshang ma rgyas kyi bar du sgo 'di nas 'thon na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi mgo bo tshal pa stong du khod cig ces pa snag tshas bris/ gtsug lag khang gi sum rim gyi bar sgo la chos min gyi rnam par rtog pa skad cig ma gcig rgyu na zhes pa zangs las bris/ sgo nang ma la lus ngag yid gsum tha mal du cung zad gcig lus na zhes dngul gyis bris/ gzim mal sogs la mal 'di las g.yos na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis mgo bo tshal pa stong du khod cig ces pa gser gyis bris nas bsgrubs pas mkha' spyod du byon no/

/jo bos kyang tshe blos gtang mthun 'jug spangs pa'i phyag len kho na mdzad/ sku gshegs pa'i rjes su yang zab chos yod zer ba'i bse'i ga'u gcig chos skyong la gtad/ kha 'byed mi nus par yod pa la hor gyis gshags nas shog ril mang po byung / sus thob byas pas/ 'chi ba yin/ 'chi ba yin/ brgya rtsa re tsam dang / nam 'chi cha med/ nam 'chi cha med/ ces pa dang / tshe ring yong na tshe ring shog /tshe thung yong na tshe thung shog /tshe ring tshe thung gnyis ka yang / /'chi ba'i tshe na de 'drar zad/ /ces pa dang / cis kyang dgos pa med dgos pa med la sogs pa mang du bris 'dug de la 'ga' zhig zab chos kyi tshugs sam zer/ bsags pa can gcig gis go ste/ tshe blos btang ste sgrub pa mdzad do// ༈ /kha rag sgom chung gi gtam rgyud la brten nas nges shes bskyed pa ni// ༈ kha rag sgom chung 'phan yul lde'u ka ru'i brag la sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe spo to bas brag pha gi na gtsang kha rag sgom chung sgom byed de/ thos chung sgom pa byed pa ni/ /lag ldum brag la 'dzegs pa 'dra/ /byed kyin zhal bag re btang bas/ grwa pa rnams kyis kyang skur pa btab pa dang / 'than tu btub nyen yang med ltar 'deng gsungs nas byon pas/ khong la ri dwags gtso bo bros song / bzhugs pa'i phyogs bzhi na tho re la yi ge re btab pa la bltas pas/ shar na/ nyam chung bdag la rkyen ngan gnod pa mang / /brtan pa thob na rkyen ngan grogs su 'char/ /nags kyi me dang me stag ji bzhin du/ /gcig pur gnas pa kho bo'i g.yar dam lags/ /lho na/ 'chi bdag bdud ni mi sdod tshur tshur yong / /de las thar ba'i thabs ni ci yang med/ /da lta gnyid dang le lo'i dbang song ste/ /ji 'dra'i dus gcig bdag la nam yong a/ /nub na/ tshe 'di'i lto rgyab ji ltar byas kyang byed/ /shi nas byang chub 'bras bu btsal thabs med/ /dgra zin sde rigs kun la ma chags par/ /bsod nams chen po myur du gsag pa gces/

/byang na/ tshe la long med tha snyad thug pa med/ /de bas dam pa'i dgongs pa longs mdzod la/ /'du 'dzi spangs nas dgon par zhi gnas bsten/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur gnas par bya/ /zhes pa mthong bas rang dpa' zhum zhing khong la nges shes skyes/ nang du phyin tsa na ri dwags phru gu rnams khong gi skyil krung la og ma bkal nas nyal/ ri dwags bzhos pa'i zho rang rang phru gu la lud pa'i chas su 'dug khong nang du byon pa dang ri dwags phru gu rnams bres rtab tu ma'i shul la bros song / nga la ri dwags 'bros khyed la mi 'bros pa gang yin byas pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar sha ma zos pa yin gsungs/ khong sngar zan chang pa re/ lo ma chang pa re la gsol rgyu mdzad pa la/ da nang lto skyid byed pa yin gsungs nas/ spo to ba la zan chang pa gnyis dang lo ma chang pa gnyis drangs/ khyed kyis nyams len ji ltar byed/ nyams su ji ltar myong byas pas/ kha rag pas bdag gis dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgoms pas tshe 'di'i blo ldog par go las rgyu 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas mi dge ba las blo ldog par go byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas/ rang gcig pu zhi bde las blo ldog par go chos thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgoms pas/ gzung 'dzin las blo ldog par go zhes gsungs pas/ spo to ba mos nas/ khyed sgom chung gcig min 'dug sgom chen gcig gda'o/ /smra ba'i seng ge gcig gda'o/ /mi'i skyes mchog gcig gda'o/ /zhes bstod pa mang po mdzad/ der khong dpon g.yog gi bsgrags pa nas snyan pa chen po byung ste/ 'phan yul bas gdan drangs nas 'bul ba chen po byas/ khyed la yul dang gzhan la khyad med pas bzhugs par zhu byas pas/ nga'i yul na dad pa lha khang nas chad pa yod pas dge sbyor la g.yengs na mi 'ong / de'i phyir yang g.yengs ba mi 'ong bas brod/ dkor sku glud med pas rig pa rang bzhin gyis dwangs/

de'i phyir yang brod gsung nas ma gsan no/ /mched zla dbang rdo rje la rta dang gos byin nas zhu rogs bcol bas kyang spun zla rta dang gos dar du mi 'tshong nged rang la yang dngos grub kyi nor lta bu yar gdan drangs nas sgrub pa byed du 'jug gsung nas ma gsan/ 'o na nged rnams la gdams pa gcig zhu byas pas/ so thub par gyis/ so thub par gyis gsungs de'i don ma go zhus pas/ da lta btsun chung rnams la'ang chos mgo thon pa mkhas pa bzang po re bya snyam 'dug bgres pa dang gnyer pa rnams la'ang rang nyid chos mgo thon pa mi chad du 'gro ba re bya snyam 'dug pas/ de rnams mnos pa bzhin gyis gsungs nas/ kha rag phug nag tu gshegs nas sgrub pa mdzad/ khong bzhugs pa'i brag phug na langs na brag zur la dbu thug nas khrag 'ong / sgo rtsar phyin na/ sgo 'phreng la tsher phung gcig yod pas tsher mas brad nas khrag 'ong ba gcig yod/ 'di gnyis gcad dgos pa 'dug snyam pa byung yang / da lta ka 'chi nyan yod snyam nas de yang gcod ma khom par thugs dam rtse gcig mdzad gsungs/ ྀatsha// ༈ /'dir bla ma kha cig gis lce sgom mkha' skyongs grags pa yin gsung yang / bdag gi bla ma'i gsung gis lce sgom nag po yin/ dga' rab rdo rje'i tshig gsum gnad rdeg gi sgo nas skyel mdzad gsung ngo // ༈ /lce sgom gyis rdzogs chen gyis chos sgo skyel mdzad pas/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i longs spyod chen po yod gsungs/ de'i dus su byang sems 'byongs nas gcan gzan dang ri dwags rnams kyang khyu 'dres nas sdod pa yod do/ /de'i snyan pa lho pa rta sgom gyis thos nas chos la 'gro byas pas/ chung ma na re dad pa thal thol mi chos kyis sad yin/ da lta mi smon rang skyid ni yod sdod zer/ ma nyan pas 'o na btsun pa gcig gyis/ btsun yun ring ba gcig gyis/ btsun khyer mkhas pa gcig gyis/ btsun mi la mi gnod pa gcig gyis zer nas ma shi bar mo rang gis rgyags bsrings/

'chi khar rgyags sring pa'i tha ma yin no zer/ khong gis byon pas mjal kha ma byung bar bsgugs pas lo gsum song ba dang / steng nas mar gzigs pas/ dbang rdor gyi zhing kha na las rogs byed pa gcig 'dug pa su yin gsung / sngar gyi lho pa de yin zer bas/ da 'phrad kyis shog gyis gsungs/ phyin pas 'gyur nas mjal kha ma byung / 'o na mar 'di rnams dkon mchog la dbul bar zhu byas nas de bshags med gsungs nas bsnams pas/ mar la 'phrad nas mi la ma 'phrad pa 'dug pa gsungs nas/ mjal kha btang gdams pa gnang ste/ da lta chos 'brel gcig zhu byas pas sdod ris mna' skyol gsung / dge slong yin pas mna' mi 'dor zhus/ slob ma gcig po de las ma skyongs gsungs/ khong gi kha rag skor gsum la bshad pa mdzad pas grwa pa stong phrag gnyis tsam 'dus/ bgres song nas mi rgan gcig gi rjes bsnyeg dgos pa yod pas grwa pa rnams gyes shig gsungs kyang gyes su ma 'dod pas/ nyin gcig rten 'brel cig yod dpe cha lha rten dang rdzas rnams phyir thon gsungs nas ston pas/ dgon pa'i mtha' gnyis nas me bcug bsregs nas phug nag tu sgrub pa mdzad/ lo gsum mdzad nas nye gnas la shog gsungs/ phyin pas gzhan gcig tu 'gro skyel thung la shog gsungs/ bzhugs par zhus pas ma gsan nas/ bdag kyang 'khrid par zhu zhus pas/ sang nyin nyi ma ri rtse la shar ba la shog gsungs/ der kho mi 'dra'i 'gor nas sang nyi ma phyed yol las ma thon pas phug nag gi brag de 'ja' yis dril nas 'dug nang du phyin pas na bza' sbu gu ha re mkha' spyod du gshegs 'dug der slob ma gcig la gzhan phan chen po byung zhing da lta kha rag sgom pa zhes mtshan thos pa tsam gyis don chen por 'gyur gyi yod pa yin gsungs/ ྀatsha// ༈ /rnal 'byor chos g.yung gis gtam rgyud la brten nas nges shes bskyed pa ni// ༈ rnal 'byor chos g.yung ni/ dwags po rin po che'i slob ma mnyes shos yin par gsungs/

thag ring gi grwa pa'am mi chen rnams kyis chos rje'i slob ma drag shos su lags zhus pas chos kyi g.yung drung gsungs/ gtum mo 'byongs pa su lags rtogs pa thob pa su lags zhus pas/ thams cad la chos kyi g.yung drung gsungs/ de'i spyod tshul ni na bza' skya man ser man gcig gsol/ phru gog gcig dang khyi lpags kyi sbud pa gcig khyer te bsod snyoms la byon nas sbang ma dang zan skam dang rtsam pa sing po gang byung thams cad phru gog tu blug rta sbangs bong sbangs/ mi lud khyi lud gdong du gang byung bsdus te sbud pa'i khud du btums/ brag phug tu bskol te zla phyed tsam re gzim gyin bzhugs/ yang slong kyin de bzhin mdzad pa gcig yod de/ khong la bla ma mnyes pas slob ma 'ga' zhig gis ma theg par rtsing po zhabs 'dren byed pa 'di la mnyes zer zhing / dus tshod gcig la slob ma'am mi chen rnams kyis bsnyen bskur byed res byas nas/ 'ga' zhig gis khyed kyis kyang bsnyen bkur byed dgos zer/ mi grub byas pas slob ma rnams kyi nang nas bzang shos bla mas mnyes shos yin pas zer nas zhag gsum gyi nyin bar khas blangs zhag gsum ka 'gro ba'i nub mo nam phyed thug pa gsol ba btab/ nam phyed nas rnal lam bzung nas lha'i yul du phyin sang snga dro chos rje rin po che'i drung du bsnyen bskur byed pa la shog cig mi yong na pho brang rnams bshig nas stong byas/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa can phyin sngar bzhin sgra dbyangs dbul du shog byas/ klu'i yul du phyin sngar bzhin byas/ lha bran dang lto phye thug la byas/ sang ja rdza 'dzugs pa la sogs pa la shog gsungs/ grab byas kho la gro yol 'gro bas la mo shog byas pas/ phru gog nang du ma bsres dgu bsres de bskol ba sbud gog gi steng du bzhag nas rin po che'i dpang du bzhag pas/ dges bzhin nas kham kham gsol te/ der gzhan rnams khrel ba'i snang ba la/

nam mkha' la sngar thos ma myong ba'i sgra dbyangs/ snas ma myong ba'i dri/ me tog gi char/ sa 'og nas dri dang mchod pa/ bar snang nas lha'i bu dang bu mos mchod pa 'bul ba sogs nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi khengs pa byung nas thams cad kyi rong rong byas pas/ rin po che'i gsung nas thams cad khad de bsdad/ rnal 'byor chos g.yung gi za zi ru 'dug pa gsung ste/ thams cad log lta sel nas rtsod med du gyur/ der khams pa rong po'i grwa pa gcig na re/ chos drug yod par 'dug pas zhus zer/ med byas pas ma nyan/ gtad pa med byas kyang ma nyan/ der phyag gnyis kyi khong gi lag pa nas bzung nas la'u nga'ang 'chi khyed kyang 'chi'o/ /nga'i yon tan rnams do nub 'chi'am sang 'chi'am snyam pa'i mi rtag pa/ bla mas mos gus/ bden med sgyu ma'i 'dun pa gsum las byung ste de las lhag pa yod ri gsungs nas dbu snyung bzhes gsung // ༈ /dam pa dmar po'i gsung la brten nas nges shes bskyed pa ni// ༈ dam pa dmar po la yon bdag yun ring po byas pa gcig gis da nga rgas 'dug pas chos tshig nyung la don 'dril ba nyams su blang bde ba gcig zhu byas pas/ tshogs brgya rtsa dang brgya 'bul gyis shig gsung / de ltar byas kyang yun ring po ma byung / da zhu lags byas pas/ gzhan gyis thos su mi btub pa yod pas tshogs kyi chas gcig gis mi med pa gcig tu 'dengs gsungs nas/ grog phug gcig tu phyin pas mi e 'dug ltos shig gsungs/ mi mi gda' byas pas da nga'i lag pa la 'jus la kha la ltos gsungs/ de ltar byas pas/ 'an nga yang 'chi/ khyod kyang 'chi 'jug byed de lta bu'i chos zab mo gcig khyod la byin pa yin gsungs/ yon bdag gis bsam pa la chos de la tshogs brgya rtsa dang brgya 'bul ci dgos mod/ nga zog rgan gcig dang 'phrad 'dug snyam pa byung / de'i nub mo gnyid tsam yang ma byung / tho rangs gnyid ri ba cig byung tsa na 'chi ba mi rtag pa rgyud la lhang lhang skyes nas byung /

de tshe 'di blos btang gi bzang po gcig byung gsungs// ༈ /zhang rin po che'i gsung la brten nas nges shes bskyed pa ni// ༈ zhang rin po che'i gsung nas/ 'khor ba las ma grol ba de gnas lugs kyi don ma rtogs pas lan/ de dad pa ma skyes pa'i lan/ de 'chi ba ma dran pas lan/ de la 'chi ba mi rtag pa gsha' ma gcig rgyud la skyes na/ nges 'byung gi dad pa lkog langs su skye ste/ tshogs bsags so/ /des sgrib pa 'dzad/ des gnas lugs kyi don rtogs nas 'khor ba las grol bar 'gyur ro gsungs// ༈ /dbang po rab 'bring gnyis la/ chos thun gsum gsum drug tsam bshad nas lung gi rgyab skyor de nges shes skyed nas 'jur du 'jug spyir yang dwags po'i lugs kyis blo spun gyis dag nas dmigs pa'i ngo gdong re ston pa las bshad pa rgyas pa mi mdzad/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi mdo rgyud kyi lung gis rgyab skyor nas nges shes bskyed nas 'jur du khrid kyi ngo bo la bcug pas mdo rgyud nas bshad pa de bsgom don du go zhing / sgom chen pa'i de mdo rgyud nas bshad pa de go ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /mdo dang rgyud dang mi mthun pa'i sgom des go mi chod de/ bhi ma las skyon bzhi bshad de/ rgyab rten lung dang bral ba/ bcos ma sel dang bcas pa/ nyams pa bdud kyis bzung ba/ bar chad rkyen du gyur pa'o/ /snang ba sems la gsum ste/ grub mtha' khas len pa ni/ myong ba gnyis med kyi shes pa rang rig rang gsal la bden 'dzin yod pa/ bka' tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa nas bshad pa ni snang ba sems/ sems ngos bzung dang bral ba'i zung 'jug yin te/ yang dag don la gnas nas ni/ /sems tsam las ni 'da' bar bya/ /snang med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi theg pa chen po mthong / /zhes gsungs so/ /sngags kyi ni snang ba sems/ sems lha'i sku ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /mtshan nyid theg pa'i lugs kyi mnyam bzhag snang stong nam mkha' lta bu dang /

rjes shes bde stong sgyu ma lta bu zhes mnyam rjes nyams len tha dad du 'dod la/ 'dir snang grags chos thams cad rang gi sems shar ba yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ sems nyid chen po gcig nyid la/ /lnga'i gzugs kyis rnam par mtshon/ /zhes phung po lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ nyon mongs pa lnga/ dbang po drug skye mched drug kha dog drug rigs drug la sogs pa thams cad rang gi sems su shar ba yin te/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /lang kar gshegs pa las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu 'byung / /don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don ni/ /phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med/ /ces so/ /chu 'gram gcig tu 'gro ba rigs drug gral la bsgrigs na/ dmyal ba'i khro chu 'khol ma/ yi dwags la rnag khrag lha min la go mtshon/ mi dang dud 'gro la chu/ nya la sogs pa la khang khyim/ lha la bdud rtsir snang ste/ mdo las/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /lha rnams ji ltar rigs drug la/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /thig le dkar dmar gyi skabs su/ thig le dkar dmar gyi dmigs pa thabs khyad par can la brten nas zin pas/ thabs lam gyis zin par 'gyur/ tho rangs rmi lam du 'od gsal gyi dus gnad du yong ba ni/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi zas zos pa rnams mnyam gnas kyi mes zhu nas snyigs ma rnams long du bskyur/ dwangs ma rnams lus la khrems nas rtsa mig rnams stong par yod pa'o/ /rtog med la 'dzin pa snga ma la bde mchog mtshon gang tsam/ dmigs pa gang bde'o/ /gnyis pa la bde mchog sku mdog dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsgom/ rtog bcas lam du byed pa'i skabs su gnyid kyi snang mched thob gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas/

gnyid mthug po'i skabs su rig pa snying kha na gnas shing / bha san ta la rlung rgyu/ de nas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo la rlung rgyu bas rmi lam gyi snang ba 'char ba'o/ /ārya de bas/ phung po khams dang skye mched tha dad kun/ /shes pa gnyis po deng 'dir rab 'dus te/ /sa mthug gyur pas 'gro ba rang gnyid log /rlung gi stobs kyis rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes so// ༈ /dbang po tha ma'i skabs su/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lung par 'gro ba la chu dang tsher ma dang / mun phrang rnams la thar na rin chen mkha' 'gro yod pa bzhin/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum la gnyen po bsten/ bsgom pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa 'byung ngo / /dbang po brgya byin gyis tshig ni/ lha ma yin gyis dmag lhags byung ba dang / da ni sra ba'i gos gyon/ rno ba'i mtshon thogs la rgyob cig ces pas lha ma yin gyi g.yul 'joms te/ 'khor los bsgyur ba tshig gis 'grub/ /lha rnams kyi ni bsam pas 'grub/ /rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin gyis 'grub/ /ces so/ /sbyangs pa la bdag med ma yong ba ni rtsa rlung thig le bdag med ma'o/ /spel ba sngon la yod kyang phyag len la sprul pa sngon la mdzad do/ /de yang gang 'phrad 'phral la sprul te/ rmog lcog pa'i zhal nas/ 'byung ba sa dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /sa ru sprul zhing sa ru bsgyur/ /'byung ba chu dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /zhes sogs 'gre'o/ /yang rmog lcog pas/ me dang chu ru sprul ba dang / 'og min la sogs mthong na dga' ste/ 'on kyang gnyid thun gcig gi dgra yin gsungs/ 'phur ba rtsal chung na skyil krung bcas pa'i mthe bong gnyis nas 'degs pa'o/ /rlung bzung na phan te/ bogs 'don rlung gi rta po yin/ /ye shes phyogs med ltad mo lta/ /zhes dang / mar pa'i zhal nas/ rmi lam dus su sgyu lus bsgom/ /snang ba spros kyin sgyu lus bsgom/ /de rtog par song yang ya mi nga / /rnam rtog chos skur shes pa'i gdeng gcig bdog
